title: character_set_server 非 utf8mb4
rationale: utf8 实际是 utf8mb3，已被 MySQL 标记 deprecated；无法存 emoji。
descriptionTpl: character_set_server = {{node.variables.character_set_server}}，无法存储 emoji / 4 字节字符；utf8 实际是 utf8mb3，已被 MySQL 标记为 deprecated
actionTpl: 服务端 + 库 + 表 + 列四级都需要改；新建表前先改服务端默认，存量表用 CONVERT TO
sqlTpl:
-- my.cnf:
character_set_server = utf8mb4
collation_server = utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci  # MySQL 8.0
# collation_server = utf8mb4_general_ci  # MySQL 5.7
-- 库级转换：
ALTER DATABASE <dbname> CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci;
